thread:
olivia: Heads up, saw a parity bug where REST model config returns retry_policy.max_retries=0 but SDK drops it, so clients end up retrying non-idempotent calls. Can repro locally.
henry: uh oh. post the exact responses?
otlivia: REST response: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/mtl-2/config | jq
# => {
#   "id": "mtl-2",
#   "max_tokens": 4096,
#   "retry_policy": {"max_retries": 0, "retry_on": ["429"]},
#   ...
# }
```
henry: and SDK?
olivia: Python SDK:
```
from redwood import ModelsClient
mc = ModelsClient()
mc.get_model_config("mtl-2")
# => {"id": "mtl-2", "maxTokens": 4096}  # retry_policy missing entirely
```
tia: that's dangerous. Our generator code treats absence of retry_policy as "use default SDK retries (3)", so POSTs to the moderation endpoint retried and caused duplicate side effects.
henry: where in SDK parsing this goes wrong?
olivia: looks like shared utils.normalize_config does `parsed = {k: v for k,v in resp.items() if v}` then camel-cases keys. That comprehension will drop dicts that are empty or falsy, or nested dicts that contain zeros. Because max_retries=0 inside retry_policy, downstream flattening logic treats retry_policy as falsy and drops it.
tia: interesting edge-case: retry_policy exists and is non-empty, but contains numeric zero which makes some check return False. Also flatten step merges nested dicts and then global filter drops because the flattened value might be 0.
ci-bot: failing test reported: sampleapp/tests/e2e/test_retry_policy_zero.py::test_no_retries_when_policy_zero - 1 failed, artifacts: ci://artifacts/2098765400/retry_test.log
henry: proposed fix: make the filter explicit: preserve values if v is not None (python) and v !== null && v !== undefined (node). Also be careful when flattening nested dicts: don't coerce them into a primitive before the filter.
olivia: I'll prepare a PR that removes the truthy filter and instead explicitly filters only None. Will add thorough unit tests for: max_retries=0, retry_on=[], retry_on null, and nested numeric zeros.
tia: also add an integration test in sampleapp that mocks REST config and asserts SDK returns identical structure (including nested objects with zero values).
henry: additional doc change: call out that retry_policy.max_retries is an integer and 0 is meaningful. Add example in API reference.
ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1142 - contains fix + tests + CHANGELOG entry. CI queued.
olivia: temporary mitigation: sampleapp quickstart patched to explicitly read raw REST config when bootstrapping feature gates, but we need SDK fix asap. I filed an issue to scan for other numeric-zero cases (backoff.initial_delay_ms, cache.ttl=0). https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/198 (numeric-zero-parity-scan)
henry: good catch. ping us when CI is green and we'll merge. Thanks for the clear repro, @olivia :rocket:
